feeds.title: Gym Momentum
feeds.description: I'm Tony Retrosi - head coach and owner of Atlantic Gymnastics Training Centers. Gymnastics is a dynamic sport, coaches are constantly evolving and sharing their knowledge with gymnasts. My goal is for this site to become a place for you to get a drill or progression AND share a drill. I hope that GYM MOMENTUM can help you stay focused, be creative, and help you blast through road blocks.

feeds.description: This blog series covers my experience as an adult gymnast, one who started in her mid-30s and is still flipping away at 50. I talk about the joys and challenges of mastering gymnastics skills with an adult mind and body, coaching, and feature an extended profile of the owner of the gym where I train, whose focus is on recreational gymnastics for our community.

feeds.title: Los Angeles School of Gymnastics Blog

TMC will cover every era of women's gymnastics from its inaugural Olympics in 1928 to the current quad.
